articles.summary: Under the LNTP, B&W will commence development, engineering and long-lead procurement activities for the project, which is intended to help support continued reliable power generation while helping the facility achieve its emissions reduction goals.
articles.title: Babcock & Wilcox Receives Award to Begin Work on Approximately $130 Million Air Quality Control Project

articles.summary: B&W is honored to be recognized as one of POWER Magazine's Best Places to Work. The recognition reflects the experiences and feedback of our employees, who highlighted the company's collaborative culture, workplace flexibility, strong working relationships and meaningful work. We are proud of our team's contributions and remain committed to investing in our people and creating an environment where individuals and teams can thrive.
articles.title: Babcock & Wilcox Recognized as a POWER Best Place to Work for 2026
